item.title: Master Interview Conciseness 🎤 • Start with a strong outcome or result first. • Use: “I improved efficiency by 30% through automation.” • Limit each answer to 1 minute; stay focused. • Prepare 2-3 key points per question. • Practice active listening to tailor responses. 🎧 How can you refine your interview answers to be more impactful? #interview #career #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
